  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "noise_monitor" and r.location == "building_exterior")

options.content:
500 ms RMS, DC removed, sampled at 16 kHz. **Estimated, unweighted dB SPL; not dBA or certified safety/compliance measurements.** Orange defaults to 80 dB, red to 95 dB; actual thresholds are plotted. A 2 dB reset hysteresis prevents flicker. Purple indicates mic fault.

Telegraf assigns receipt timestamps. Missing noise values on mic faults are intentional. Stat panels use only the last 15 seconds; **No data** means the cloud path has stopped or no fresh sample exists. The trend shows the latest sampled window per plot interval, not a continuous recording or Leq. No raw audio is stored.
